responsibility: Provides the generated documentation URL mapping for the Epiphany target’s -m options defined in epiphany.opt. Each entry associates an option name with the corresponding manual anchor in the GCC HTML docs via UrlSuffix records, so GCC’s option metadata and diagnostic/help infrastructure can link Epiphany-specific switches such as call, FP mode, vector, and register-selection options back to their user documentation. Unlike epiphany.opt, it does not define option semantics or variables; it supplies the doc-reference companion table consumed by generated option machinery.
